parts.1:
Questions 1–5

1 Which is the boy’s bedroom?

Girl: What’s your bedroom like?

Boy: Well, when you go into the room, my bed’s along the wall on the left. And opposite that, is my desk, with a chair of course.

Girl: And is there a bookcase or anything?

Boy: It’s too small for that. I have a wardrobe for my clothes, but that’s not in my room, it’s actually in the hall outside.

2 What does the girl want to buy?

Man: Can I help?

Girl: Yes, I need something to take to a music festival. Is this one any good?

Man: It’s excellent. It’s made of special stuff, so you’ll stay completely dry, even when it’s pouring with rain. Also, it doesn’t let light in, so it’ll still be dark inside. You can sleep, even when it’s bright and sunny outside.

Girl: That sounds perfect! I’ll take the green one.

3 What did the man do on his holiday?

Woman: How was your holiday?

Man: Amazing! I’ve been skiing before, but this was my first time snowboarding.

Woman: Was it easier than skiing?

Man: Yes, I think it was and very different. The snow was perfect and the mountains were so beautiful. I’d even like to go back to the same place for a walking holiday when the snow’s gone.

Woman: Cool!

4 What does the boy’s mother do?

Boy: Hi Mum, how was work?

Mum: Quite good today, thanks. I did a job for an engineer. She’s just finished building a petrol station, and she wanted me to take some pictures of it.

Boy: Oh, that’s unusual!

Mum: And my second customer was a musician. He wanted a photo of him with his guitar for his website.

Boy: Oh, nice one! You meet lots of interesting people as a photographer.

5 What does the girl want to do with her friends?

Dad: What do you want to do for your birthday this year?

Girl: Well, not something that’s planned. Like ice skating – that was cool when I was 11. Now I’m nearly 14, it’s different.

Dad: OK. Why not invite some friends around and watch a few music videos?

Girl: That’s a good idea. Unless Susie decides to sing all the songs! She never knows the words!
parts.2:
Questions 6–10

Mark: Welcome everybody to your weekend at Longnor Activity Centre. I’m the manager; my name’s Mark. If you need me, my number is 07302 874 266. I’m here to help.

You’ll have lunch soon, and that will finish about one thirty-five. And then you’ll need to be at reception at one forty-five, so please be quick after lunch! We’ve had to change our timetable – you were told that the first activity after lunch is cycling. But, actually, you’re going to start with climbing today instead. And after that it’s tennis. And then this evening, we’re going out for a picnic supper. I’ll tell you where we’re going, so you can look online and see what a beautiful place it is – it’s called Fairbourne Lake. That’s F-A-I-R-B-O-U-R-N-E. It takes about 40 minutes to get there on foot. For some reason, people often seem to lose their phone at the lake, so it’s better to leave yours in your room. But please don’t forget a towel, because it is possible to swim there.
parts.3:
Questions 11–15

Headteacher: Isabel, well done this term!

Isabel: Thank you.

Headteacher: Your teachers say it’s brilliant having you in class. Often, when they ask a question, you’ll have something good to say, even when they’re hard questions about the homework.

Isabel: Thank you.

Headteacher: What’s your favourite subject?

Isabel: Physics. It’s interesting that my marks from the teacher have improved so much. That’s why I like it.

Headteacher: Great. Tell me about theatre studies.

Isabel: Our class did a play this term. One group wrote it. My job was to make the actor’s costumes.

Headteacher: Brilliant! Which subject has been most difficult?

Isabel: Maybe chemistry. It’s never been my best subject.

Headteacher: But you wanted to do a university course to become a vet, right?

Isabel: Yes.

Headteacher: Well, you’ll need to know about the stuff in medicines for animals. So, school chemistry can be useful for that. So, do work hard on your chemistry, OK?

Isabel: All right, thank you.

Headteacher: And… you did very well in the Italian exam!

Isabel: Yes, I couldn’t believe it. It’s a shame the teacher’s leaving because she’s really nice. Will there be a new teacher?

Headteacher: Yes, he’s starting next term.
parts.4:
Questions 16–20

16 You will hear two classmates talking. What are they doing?

Boy: Most people’s email address is just their first name and last name. That’s so boring! My brother doesn’t use his name at all – he’s banana.face@yesmail.com!

Girl: Seriously? That’s strange! My cousin does that too. She calls herself chocolatebiscuit@zmail.com!

Boy: Wow!

Girl: You should get a crazy email too – maybe bigfootballfan@something.com

Boy: I’m not sure that’s for me!

17 You will hear a teacher talking to a boy who is late for a lesson. What is the teacher talking about?

Boy: Sorry I’m late. My mum couldn’t find–

Teacher: I don’t need to know that. You need to always be here at the correct time, so the lesson can start on time.

Boy: I’m sorry.

Teacher: If one person’s late, we all have to stop. So please, I don’t mind how you do it, but make sure you’re always on time.

Boy: OK.

18 You will hear a boy telling his classmate about a book he is reading. How did he get the book?

Boy: I’m reading that book – The Explorer – it’s brilliant!

Girl: Oh, did you find it in the school library?

Boy: I looked there, but someone had already taken it out. A friend offered to lend me his copy, but not until he’s finished it. That won’t be for a couple of weeks. So in the end I just got myself one from the bookshop.

Girl: Can I borrow it?

Boy: Sure.

19 You will hear two friends discussing videos they have just watched. What are they talking about?

Girl: Those videos were so funny! Especially the cat jumping into the air when its owner’s phone rang!

Boy: I laughed more at that other one, the one with the cat and dog dancing together.

Girl: Oh, that wasn’t as funny as the one with the cat watching the baby rabbits.

Boy: Yeah, I loved that one, too! Probably funnier than all the others we’ve seen.

20 You will hear a girl telling her parents about a lesson. What is she doing?

Girl: It was brilliant in Biology today. The teacher gave us all a sheet and said ‘Use this to revise for the exam’. So I looked at mine – it was the actual exam paper. She’d given us the wrong sheet! But then she realised and took them all back. She was really nice about it and said ‘Oh, I’m so sorry’!
parts.5:
Questions 21–25

Girl: You know we can choose different school science project? Well, Harriet’s going to watch bees and learn all about them.

Mother: Oh!

Girl: And you know Tom’s got a pet mouse.

Mother: Really!

Girl: Well, he’s going to make a place with everything it needs.

Mother: What, to live in?

Girl: Exactly.

Mother: What about Emma?

Girl: Well, she read an online article about a park with some unusual plants. So, her plan’s to go and see them.

Mother: Oh, where’s that?

Girl: Near the hospital I think.

Mother: And Jack – he’s probably going to make a model of something, is he?

Girl: Actually no, he wants to do a video of himself, and explain why he wants to become a doctor.

Mother: Interesting. Is Louisa doing something about aeroplanes?

Girl: Yes, she wants to build one from wood. Just a little one.

Mother: Perhaps she can go to the park and see if it flies?

Girl: Well no, it won’t fly. It’s just to show what it looks like.

Mother: I see.

Girl: And Alfredo found an article about how old railway engines work.

Mother: Oh, so is he making a film about that?

Girl: No, just finding out about them, I think.

explanations.p1q1: 男孩说床沿着左墙、对面是书桌和椅子（"my bed’s along the wall on the left. And opposite that, is my desk, with a chair of course."），房间太小放不下书柜（"It’s too small for that."），衣柜在门外走廊里（"it’s actually in the hall outside"）；B 有衣柜、C 有书架，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q2: 女孩要为音乐节买帐篷，店主说料子特殊、"you’ll stay completely dry, even when it’s pouring with rain"，而且"it doesn’t let light in, so it’ll still be dark inside"，晴天也能在里面睡（"You can sleep, even when it’s bright and sunny outside."），完全防水不透光，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q3: 男士说"I’ve been skiing before, but this was my first time snowboarding."，这是他第一次玩单板滑雪；女士问"Was it easier than skiing?"他答"Yes, I think it was"，因此选择 B。
explanations.p1q4: 男孩问妈妈工作情况，妈妈说给刚建好加油站的工程师拍照——"she wanted me to take some pictures of it"——又给音乐人拍了他和吉他的照片，男孩最后说"You meet lots of interesting people as a photographer."，可见妈妈是摄影师，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q5: 女孩说"not something that’s planned. Like ice skating – that was cool when I was 11."，不想像 11 岁时那样去滑冰；爸爸提议"Why not invite some friends around and watch a few music videos?"，她觉得是个好主意，因此选择 B。
explanations.p2q1: 正确答案是 07302874266。Mark 说"If you need me, my number is 07302 874 266."，即 07302 874 266，连写为 07302874266。
explanations.p2q2: 正确答案是 1:45。Mark 说午饭"will finish about one thirty-five"，但真正的集合时间是"you’ll need to be at reception at one forty-five"，即 1:45；不要把午饭结束的 1:35 误填进去。
explanations.p2q3: 正确答案是 climbing。Mark 说"We’ve had to change our timetable"，原通知里午后第一项活动是 cycling，但"you’re going to start with climbing today instead"，所以今天的第一个活动是攀岩；cycling 是被更改掉的原安排，不要误填。
explanations.p2q4: 正确答案是 Fairbourne。Mark 说晚上出去野餐晚餐，地点"it’s called Fairbourne Lake. That’s F-A-I-R-B-O-U-R-N-E."，还逐字拼读确认了拼写。
explanations.p2q5: 正确答案是 towel。Mark 说"But please don’t forget a towel, because it is possible to swim there."，那里可以游泳所以别忘了带毛巾；手机是让大家留在房间里（"it’s better to leave yours in your room"），不是要带的东西。
explanations.p3q1: 校长转述老师们的话"it’s brilliant having you in class. Often, when they ask a question, you’ll have something good to say, even when they’re hard questions about the homework."，老师们高兴的是她常在课堂提问时给出好的回答，即使是很难的作业问题，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q2: Isabel 说"It’s interesting that my marks from the teacher have improved so much. That’s why I like it."，成绩进步很大正是她喜欢物理的原因，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q3: Isabel 说"Our class did a play this term. One group wrote it. My job was to make the actor’s costumes."，写剧本是另一组的事，她的任务是给演员做服装（costumes），因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q4: 校长说 Isabel 想当兽医，"you’ll need to know about the stuff in medicines for animals. So, school chemistry can be useful for that."，学校化学课对她的未来有帮助，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q5: 校长说"And… you did very well in the Italian exam!"，Isabel 回答"Yes, I couldn’t believe it."，她对自己考得好感到难以置信，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q1: 男孩说"My brother doesn’t use his name at all – he’s banana.face@yesmail.com!"，女孩说表妹"She calls herself chocolatebiscuit@zmail.com!"，还建议"You should get a crazy email too – maybe bigfootballfan@something.com"，两人一直在讨论这些不寻常的邮箱地址，因此选择 C；两人并没有互相交换或挑选邮箱地址。
explanations.p4q2: 男孩想解释迟到原因，老师说"I don’t need to know that. You need to always be here at the correct time, so the lesson can start on time."，还说"If one person’s late, we all have to stop."，他谈的是必须准时到课、课才能准点开始的重要性，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q3: 学校图书馆那本"someone had already taken it out"，朋友愿意借但"not until he’s finished it"（要等几周），所以"So in the end I just got myself one from the bookshop."，他是自己买的，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q4: 女孩说"Those videos were so funny! Especially the cat jumping into the air when its owner’s phone rang!"，男孩更喜欢"the one with the cat and dog dancing together"，女孩又提"the one with the cat watching the baby rabbits"，两人比较的是哪段猫视频最搞笑，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q5: 女孩说老师发复习卷时"She’d given us the wrong sheet!"——发的是"the actual exam paper"，之后"she realised and took them all back"还道歉说"‘Oh, I’m so sorry’!"，她在讲老师犯的这个错误，因此选择 C。
explanations.p5q1: Tom 养宠物鼠，女孩说他"he’s going to make a place with everything it needs."，妈妈问"What, to live in?"，女孩答"Exactly."，即给动物建一个住的家，因此选择 A（build a home for an animal）。
explanations.p5q2: Emma 读了一篇网上文章，"she read an online article about a park with some unusual plants. So, her plan’s to go and see them."，她要去参观那个有罕见植物的公园，因此选择 G（visit a park）；文章只是她的信息来源，不是要写文章（H）。
explanations.p5q3: Jack "wants to do a video of himself, and explain why he wants to become a doctor."，即拍一部影片，因此选择 C（make a film）；妈妈猜他要"make a model of something"被女孩否定（"Actually no"），想当医生只是视频内容，不是去找医生（E）。
explanations.p5q4: Louisa 想用木头做一架小飞机，"Yes, she wants to build one from wood. Just a little one."，而且"it won’t fly. It’s just to show what it looks like."，只是展示外观的模型，因此选择 D（make a model）。
explanations.p5q5: Alfredo "found an article about how old railway engines work."，妈妈问是不是要拍成电影，女孩说"No, just finding out about them, I think."，他只是想了解老式火车，因此选择 B（learn about trains）。
